title: IFF joins Global Fragrance Summit 2027 as Gold Sponsor
summary: The International Fragrance Association ( IFRA ) is pleased to welcome IFF , a founding member of IFRA , as a Gold Sponsor of Global Fragrance Summit 2027 in Mumbai.

extraction.key_fact: IFF가 글로벌 프래그런스 서밋 2027의 골드 스폰서로 참여한다.
extraction.key_fact_quote: The International Fragrance Association ( IFRA ) is pleased to welcome IFF , a founding member of IFRA , as a Gold Sponsor of Global Fragrance Summit 2027 in Mumbai.
